original: Hiking and enjoying wine? Of course! The sunny western slopes of the WPRPLACE make it possible. We hiked along the WPRPLACE Panorama Trail and other routes through low mountain landscapes rich in history and species. Text: Christian Haas, Photos: Frank Heuer
